requirements.description:
Define the following terms:
  - Alkaline paper / acidic paper
  - Cropping
  - Lignin / lignin-free
  - Layout
  - Album
Know why a scrapbook keeps photographs from fading.
Know what the following items are used for and show that you can use them correctly:
Demonstrate a basic style of hand lettering.
List the supplies needed to start a scrapbook.

Complete 2 scrapbook pages of 304 mm x 304 mm (12 x 12 in) or 216 mm x 279 mm (8.5 x 11 in) (one sheet, front and back):
  a) One page on a theme of your choice.
  b) One page on a theme about your Pathfinder Club.
  i) Choose a theme for the page
  ii) Collect and arrange pictures to illustrate the theme
  iii) Match stickers, die-cuts and papers to the theme
  iv) Create the page
